# RB-<n>: <incident type>
Owner: <team>   Reviewed: <date>
Trigger      — the alert(s) that open this runbook, with links
Classify     — observations that confirm the type, each with
               the exact dashboard or query
Decide       — decision points with explicit criteria
Act          — commands or config changes, copy-pasteable,
               with the rollback for each
Verify       — how health is proven (for quality: an evaluation
               re-run, never a graph alone)
Communicate  — template for the tenant channel; cadence
Close        — postmortem trigger; what to attach
